Charles 2019 (PMC6587787) full text. Its stated comparison cites native-FGF21 papers (refs 6 Kharitonenkov 2007 monkeys, 20 Xu 2009, 21 Coskun 2008 mice), not Mu 2012: model_src mismatch. Partial match -> same per v3; see rule question 3.
Stanislaus 2017 (PMID 28324011) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract; paywalled.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (year = earliest public comparison); one entry per change of status
entries.note: Rosenstock 2023 quote verbatim (abstract). But the monkey track's own drug, efruxifermin, already reproduced the adiponectin/lipid PD in T2D patients in Kaufman 2020 (10.1016/j.xcrm.2020.100057, pairing with Stanislaus 2017): track turns same in 2020.
Mu 2012 abstract sentence verbatim; no exposure target or margin stated.
Sanyal 2019 (PMID 30554783) quote verbatim in abstract; NCT02413372 results posted 2020-01-28 confirmed. 'Reached, drug worked' applied with no model exposure target; see rule question 2.

Charles 2019 ref 8 is the Krupinski 2016 AASLD abstract (Hepatology 64 Suppl 1), no DOI/PMID, not openable. Congress abstract is not a rule-2 tier; model_src_tier 1 is wrong. Untested is safe. Rule question 1.
FALCON 1 (PMID 37088457) quote verbatim in abstract; NCT03486899 results 2022-09-09 confirmed; no pegbelfermin phase 3 registered. Same model-side admissibility caveat as dose 3 (rule question 1).
Stanislaus 2017 abstract quote verbatim; no human target stated at abstract level.

entries.rule: evidence rule 6 (dating) and the dose table row 'reached, drug worked'
entries.note: ENLIVEN (PMID 37356033) quote verbatim; NCT04929483 results 2026-01-06 confirmed. Same track already scores BALANCED 2021 (Harrison 2021, efruxifermin, liver-fat primary met at reached doses) in efficacy; dose should turn same in 2021, not 2023.
Mu 2012 full-text sentence verbatim; db/db steatosis prediction only.
Sanyal 2019 abstract quote verbatim; registry primary = MRI-PDFF change at week 16 (confirmed); endpoint_role primary correct; year 2018 (epub 2018-12-13) correct.
Stanislaus 2017 abstract quote verbatim.

Harrison 2021 (PMID 34239138) abstract quote verbatim; NCT03976401 results 2022-08-04 not re-checked. Pairing is loose: Stanislaus abstract lists only 'metabolic parameters', liver fat in monkeys unconfirmed at abstract level.
Charles 2019 sentence verbatim and its ref 8 is the 2016 congress abstract; the model side itself cannot be opened and is not a rule-2 tier. Rule question 1.

FALCON 1 quote verbatim (abstract); all four patient_trials quotes verbatim in abstracts and all registry dates confirmed via CT.gov API. Contra holds only if the congress-abstract model side is admissible (rule question 1).
Wei 2012 (PMID 22315431) abstract quote verbatim; native FGF21, product_in_model false correctly set.

Charles 2019 full text: sentence is DXA BMD at femoral neck/hip/spine, 'data not shown'. NCT02413372 registry (2020-01-28) shows femoral-neck -2.79% (10 mg QD) vs -0.11% placebo, SD 4.3, untested: low confidence is right.

Kaufman 2020 (PMC7659583) full text: quote verbatim; the paper itself sets DIO-mouse bone loss (ref 26) beside pegbelfermin BMD, so comparison_stated true holds; it also cites a DIO-mouse rhFGF21 study with no bone loss (ref 27).

CPT 2023 (PMID 37696614) abstract quote verbatim; abstract says simulations 'provide the rationale for dose selection' for ENLIVEN, so 2021 proxy first-use (ENLIVEN start 2021-06-04, CT.gov) holds. Paywalled; abstract only.

NEJM abstract quote verbatim. Model fitted to NCT04048135 (primary completion 2020-08-28) and chose ENLIVEN's 30 mg QW/44 mg Q2W before the trial, so prospective, not retro; both arms met fibrosis primary. Registry results date 2026-01-06 confirmed.
Same CPT 2023 abstract, quote verbatim. HFF >=30% at 30 mg QW is the model's own readout; 2021 proxy year consistent with ENLIVEN start. Abstract only.

NEJM abstract quote verbatim; fibrosis primary met at 30 mg QW (26%) and 44 mg Q2W (27%). Prediction preceded the result, so same. ENLIVEN HFF responder data not retrievable (PMC full text unavailable); direction_only stands.
Toxicol Appl Pharmacol 2021 (PMID 34364948, online 2021-08-06) abstract quote verbatim; 0.7-2.2x human AUC at 20 mg QW margin stated. Abstract only; no GI or clinical-sign data in it.

Kaufman 2020 full text (PMC7659583) quote verbatim. Retro is right: monkey doses benchmarked to the 20 mg QW dose fixed after phase 2a, and the 12-week (NCT02097277, completed 2015-09) and 16-week (NCT02413372, 2017-01) BMD data predate any plausible 1-year study; run dates unverifiable (paywalled).
Tillman 2022 (PMC9306736) full text read; quote verbatim in abstract. Studies at Charles River, undated; no NOAEL/margin stated, so no dose entry is correct.

Quote verbatim (abstract and conclusions). Retro holds: the efruxifermin phase 1 MAD is Amgen's NCT01856881 (2013-03 to 2015-03, terminated, no results posted), years before Akero's rat tox; draft note that Kaufman cites no CT.gov record is wrong, but registry_date null still stands (no results posted).
Frayling 2018 (PMC5912948) abstract quote verbatim; full text also reports three protein-truncating FGF21 variants from exome data, so the combined model name is supported. Year 2018 correct.

Kaufman 2020 full text quote verbatim; the source explicitly states the comparison. Frayling 2018 was not motivated by AKR-001 and the phase 1 BP data (NCT01856881, 2013-15) were unpublished until 2020, so same rather than retro under decision 10; see rule question.
Li 2017 JBMR (PMID 27505721) abstract quote verbatim; online 2016-09-09, print 2017 as recorded. rhFGF21 proxy, product_in_model false, is allowed.

entries.rule: 7 (dating: earliest date the comparison was public; decision 1 allows a drafter-made comparison)
entries.note: Kaufman 2020 quote verbatim and ref 27 (Li 2017) sits beside the pegbelfermin BMD sentence; same holds. Year should be 2018: the identical 12-week BMD datum dates the Wei track's safety 2 to 2018 (Charles, Obesity, epub 2018; registry 2019-05-09), and a drafter-made comparison with Li 2016 was possible then.

missing: Member-drug monkey bone model with a stated margin: pegbelfermin 1-year skeletally-mature cynomolgus study (Toxicol Appl Pharmacol 2021, doi 10.1016/j.taap.2021.115673, PMID 34364948) at 0.7-2.2x human AUC (20 mg QW) found no bone effects and states 'low potential for negative effects on bone quality in adult humans'. A second bone track (margin_stated true); retro vs same depends on when the study was run (rule question 4).

Member-drug rat BP/sympathetic model: efruxifermin 4/26-week Sprague Dawley tox (Br J Pharmacol 2022, doi 10.1111/bph.15725, PMID 34773249) states 'absence of an increase in sympathetic tone in rats mirrors the unchanged salivary cortisol and systemic blood pressure following efruxifermin treatment in humans' (Kaufman 2020 PK-PD). Stated comparison, published after the human data: retro. Rats also ate more, matching the increased-appetite AE.

Human-genetic model on blood pressure: Kaufman 2020 (doi 10.1016/j.xcrm.2020.100057) compares the absence of a BP effect of efruxifermin with FGF21 loss-of-function variant carriers having higher BP (its ref 28); model_kind human_genetic, no track.

Monkey-track safety silence: tremor (Kaufman 2020: product-related withdrawals for tremor at 140 mg QW efruxifermin) and GI AEs (diarrhoea/nausea, the class's commonest harm) are harms a cynomolgus monkey could show; Stanislaus 2017 / Rosenstock 2023 say nothing. No safety entry exists on the obese-diabetic-cyno-monkey track; the pegbelfermin 1-year monkey paper (clinical observations, food intake) could settle whether monkeys predicted GI effects.

Later mouse bone model that reversed Wei 2012: Kaufman 2020 ref 27, a DIO-mouse rhFGF21 study finding no bone loss (likely Li et al., J Bone Miner Res 2017, Amgen); a separate track or a retrodiction on the bone question, absent from the draft.

Pegozafermin phase 1b/2a in NASH patients (Loomba, Lancet Gastroenterol Hepatol 2022, doi 10.1016/s2468-1253(22)00347-8, NCT04048135, epub 2022-12-12): MASH-patient adiponectin/liver-fat PD for the monkey track one year before ENLIVEN; dates the subjects=patients engagement datum earlier than the healthy-volunteer SAD.

Non-member FGF21 analogues with tier-1 stated monkey-to-human comparisons: PF-05231023 (Talukdar 2016, doi 10.1016/j.cmet.2016.02.001; raised BP/heart rate in one human study) and LY2405319 (Gaich 2013, doi 10.1016/j.cmet.2013.08.005). Outside the member list, so not scored; see rule question 5.

Could not verify: no phase 3 topline for SYNCHRONY Histology (efruxifermin) or ENLIGHTEN-Fibrosis (pegozafermin; 89bio guides 1H 2027) was found by web search as of 2026-11-05; no BMS press release on pegbelfermin discontinuation was checked beyond the registry (no phase 3 registered).
rule_questions: Is a congress abstract (Hepatology 2016;64 Suppl 1:749A, no DOI/PMID), reached only through a trial paper's citing sentence, an admissible model side? Rule 2 lists no such tier. If not, the nash-fibrosis-mouse track has no model source and the class's fibrosis endpoint (FALCON 1/2 failed, HARMONY and ENLIVEN met) has no track at all.

When the model stated no exposure target or tolerability margin, does the dose table's 'reached, drug worked' / 'reached, failed' row still apply (as the draft does for dose 2, 4 and 6), or is dose 'untested' because there was no prediction to reach?

One stated comparison that half matches (triglycerides, adiponectin) and half contradicts (glucose, insulin, weight) on the model's own readouts, with the source framing it as a contrast: v3 says partial -> same + source_calls_it partial. Confirm that is intended when the quoted sentence states the contradiction.

A member-drug toxicology study run before but published after the human result (pegbelfermin 1-year monkey bone, 2021 vs BMD known 2018-2019): retro or same? Decision 10 keys on when the model was 'built or run', which a publication date does not show.

Non-member drugs of the same mechanism (PF-05231023, LY2405319) carry tier-1 monkey-to-human comparisons including a BP/heart-rate harm. Are they set aside entirely, or does safety's 'other' (same platform) admit them?

Dating across comparison kinds on one track: can a pairing (comparison_stated false, Kaufman 2020) set the year of a track's 'same' earlier than a later stated comparison (Rosenstock 2023), or does the stated one govern the date?

Independent human-genetic model (Frayling 2018) published after a sponsor-internal, unpublished patient result (Amgen AKR-001 MAD NCT01856881, 2013-2015, no results posted; published Kaufman 2020): decision 10 needs 'post-dates and is motivated by', so scored same, not retro. Confirm that unpublished sponsor data do not make a later independent model a retrodiction.
